method.data: No Google Search Console API/script or token exists in the repo (checked scripts/, .github/workflows, docs/BLOG-RUNBOOK.md) – gap research used public keyword logic: high-volume exam/grammar/skill intents per market x Lexkite features, matched against every existing post (translationKey, keyword, slug in content/blog/*/*.md, 468 posts) and the already-scheduled queue. When GSC export becomes available, re-rank 'priority' by impressions with no matching post and pages ranking 8–30.
rules: One primary keyword per post per language (briefs.json rule). Reuse the translationKey listed here so hreflang joins the language versions.
Where 'otherKeys' lists older keys for the same topic in some languages, do NOT write a second post in those languages; link to the existing post instead.
English originals are the source for localisation: keep structure (sections, self-check, FAQ), rewrite examples around the target market's typical L1 mistakes, use the native keyword in langTargets.
Schedule with node scripts/blog-schedule.mjs --lang <lang> (≤1 post/language/day, same cluster ≥7 days apart). Gates: blog-check, blog-dupes, blog-schedule --verify, npm test.

Images: per-post shots: (alt left empty = auto alt from the real capture) + diagrams:. Shared media:<id> images only when the alt matches content/blog/shots.json desc exactly (memory blog-image-alt-review).
method.fields: id = English slug; translationKey = key shared by all language versions; keyword = English primary keyword; langTargets = languages still missing this topic with a suggested native keyword (verify with the market's search suggestions before writing); intent; feature = app deep link (/app/#/…); shots = routes for per-post screenshots; cluster; priority 1 (highest) – 3; status = written (batch 1) | planned.

nextBatches: Weekly run (after the 1M program): take 10–15 items from progress.remaining.priority1_localise, choosing languages with the lowest postsNext30DaysByLang, then update progress (move items to done, refresh counts).

When priority-1 is empty: write the en original of the next priority-2 topic (ielts opinion essay, band descriptors, lexical resource, complex sentences, order of adjectives, intonation, how to read IPA, TOEIC Part 7, TOEIC Part 2, TOEFL write an email, ielts vs toefl…), mark it status: written, then localise its langTargets.

Every batch: native rewrite (not translation) with local L1 mistakes, 1,400–2,200 words, quiz + self-check + FAQ, >=3 inbound links from same-language posts, briefs.json entry, blog-schedule --from >=36 h ahead; gates blog-check, blog-dupes, blog-schedule --verify, test/blog-images, test/blog-captions, npm test.
